honesty_boundary.selection_cost_note: A selector is end-to-end-like only if it finds a below-rho candidate and its whole selected leaf set costs less than rho on that transfer.

summary.worker_interpretation: Existing public-prefix selectors can cover some held-out winning leaves, but none both finds a below-rho candidate and keeps the selected-set cost below rho. The next useful step is a salt-conditioned FFE predictor, not another fixed feature-prefix ranker.
